title: Detailed flower pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- flower stem and leaves -->
  <path d='M50 48 Q49 60 50 72' stroke='#3fbf5a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='60' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#4ad06a' transform='rotate(-25 40 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='60' rx='11' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0a4' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(-25 40 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='55' rx='11' ry='6' fill='#3fbf5a' transform='rotate(25 61 55)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='55' rx='11' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#8ef0a4' stroke-width='1.5' transform='rotate(25 61 55)'/>
  <!-- flower petals -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='9' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='31' r='9' fill='#ff7fb8'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='44' r='9' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='9' fill='#ff7fb8'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='44' r='9' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='31' r='9' fill='#ff7fb8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- petal highlights -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffc2dc'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='29' r='3' fill='#ffc2dc'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='42' r='3' fill='#ffc2dc'/>
  <!-- flower center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='8' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ffe896' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#c98a12'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#c98a12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#c98a12'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='44' height='9' rx='3' fill='#e07b39'/>
  <rect x='28' y='70' width='44' height='9' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#ffb27a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pot body -->
  <path d='M31 79 L36 95 Q37 98 40 98 L60 98 Q63 98 64 95 L69 79 Z' fill='#c9602a'/>
  <path d='M33 79 L38 95' stroke='#ffa86a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M67 79 L62 95' stroke='#ffa86a' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- pot decorative band -->
  <path d='M34 86 L66 86' stroke='#ffb27a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='91' r='1.6' fill='#ffd2a8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='91' r='1.6' fill='#ffd2a8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='91' r='1.6' fill='#ffd2a8'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <path d='M33 76 Q50 72 67 76 L67 79 L33 79 Z' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='77' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a42'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='77' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a42'/>
</svg>
